clause: SCHEMAFULL studio_* SurrealDB records + forward-only SurrealKit rollouts (foundation set) [STU-ARC-004,STU-CON-004]

scope.summary: Author forward-only SurrealKit rollouts for SCHEMAFULL studio_* record types (studio_document SDOC-, studio_layer SLYR-, studio_artboard SART-, studio_page_spread SPGS-, studio_history_entry SHIS-, studio_edit_proposal SEPR-), with typed record ids, required EventLedger record links, authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS, and typed SurrealDB-store writes. PostgreSQL and SQLite are forbidden.
acceptance_criteria: foundation SCHEMAFULL records roll forward through SurrealKit on managed SurrealDB; PostgreSQL/SQLite rejected; typed-store and record-user permissions proven
proof_targets: live SurrealDB namespace/database SurrealKit rollout + typed-store/write-permission test
expected_tests: live-SurrealDB: forward-only SurrealKit rollout applies cleanly and canonical records reread
test: no_legacy_database_tripwire rejects PostgreSQL/SQLite and any studio_* write outside the typed SurrealDB boundary

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No durable authority store; edits cannot promote.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
